'''Character recycling''' is a term used when a single visual design for the [[Pokémon animated series]] is used in multiple episodes for different, unrelated characters, usually [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. When character recycling occurs, the characters are generally identical in appearance, with only small cosmetic changes like hair color differing between episodes.

==''Pokémon the Series''==
===[[Tracey Sketchit]] and [[Tad]]===
[[File:Tracey debut.png|thumb|left|220px|Tracey Sketchit]]
[[File:Tad.png|thumb|220px|Tad]]
[[File:Tracey lookalike EP146.png|thumb|220px|The lookalike (right)]]
[[File:Tracey lookalike EP169.png|thumb|220px|The other lookalike]]
Tracey Sketchit debuted in ''[[EP084|The Lost Lapras]]'' as a {{ashfr|traveling companion}} of {{Ash}}'s. A lookalike by the name of Tad later appeared in ''[[EP105|Charizard Chills]]''. An unnamed lookalike later appeared in ''[[EP146|Tricks of the Trade]]''. Another unnamed lookalike later appeared in ''[[EP169|Beauty and the Breeder]]''.
{{-}}
